answer: Compare every answer in an epoch against all the others with embedding similarity. One operator running hundreds of agents tends to reuse the same prompt and model, so their answers drift together like a smoke plume bending one way in the wind. When a cluster scores far closer than independent writers ever do, pay it as a single agent. Rewording each answer helps a little, but a fleet still leaves a shared stylistic cipher, and paraphrasing at scale costs more than it earns. Honest agents stay scattered like fish around a reef.
